# Relay


Relay basically acts as a bridge for the browsers to use the true power of P2P using the hyperswarm.


# Usage


Usage of relay is pretty simple, you will just run the relay via `npm run relay`

It listens on `ws://localhost:8080`. The web app uses it by itself when the page is opened on localhost or a LAN address. For any other relay, add it in the admin ui (Relays tab) and set it as default, its saved in the vault as `config/default_relay`. The cli doesnt need a relay.
